```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo    = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.width  = 7,
  fig.height = 5
)

# Load from the selected project environment. Report missing packages without
# installing into a user's library during a render.
load_pkgs <- function(pkgs) {
  missing <- pkgs[!vapply(pkgs, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
  if (length(missing)) {
    stop(
      "Missing packages: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "), "\n",
      "Add these packages using the project's package-management method,\n",
      "record their versions, and rerun this report.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  invisible(lapply(pkgs, library, character.only = TRUE, quietly = TRUE))
}
load_pkgs(c(
  "tidyverse", "tidytext", "janitor", "skimr", "naniar", "visdat", "corrplot",
  "GGally", "scales", "knitr", "kableExtra", "mgcv", "readxl", "arrow", "tools", "fs"
))

# ---- Helpers ----

read_data <- function(path) {
  ext <- tolower(tools::file_ext(path))
  switch(
    ext,
    csv     = readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE),
    tsv     = readr::read_tsv(path, show_col_types = FALSE),
    txt     = readr::read_delim(path, show_col_types = FALSE),
    xlsx    = readxl::read_excel(path, sheet = 1, .name_repair = "minimal"),
    xls     = readxl::read_excel(path, sheet = 1, .name_repair = "minimal"),
    parquet = arrow::read_parquet(path),
    stop("Unsupported file extension: ", ext)
  )
}

parse_param <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || identical(x, "null") || identical(x, "")) return(NULL)
  if (length(x) == 1L && grepl(",", x)) {
    strsplit(x, ",\\s*")[[1]] |> trimws()
  } else {
    as.character(x)
  }
}

OUTCOME   <- parse_param(params$outcome)
EXPOSURES <- parse_param(params$exposures)
GROUPING  <- parse_param(params$grouping)

theme_set(
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = NA)
    )
)
```

```{r load-data}
dat <- read_data(params$data_path) |> clean_names()

n_rows      <- nrow(dat)
n_cols      <- ncol(dat)
n_numeric   <- sum(sapply(dat, is.numeric))
n_character <- sum(sapply(dat, is.character))
n_factor    <- sum(sapply(dat, is.factor))
n_logical   <- sum(sapply(dat, is.logical))
n_date      <- sum(sapply(dat, function(x) inherits(x, c("Date", "POSIXct", "POSIXlt"))))

dat_numeric <- dat |> select(where(is.numeric))
dat_cat     <- dat |> select(where(~ is.character(.) | is.factor(.)))
```

# Per-column profile

```{r}
summarize_var <- function(x, n_total) {
  is_num <- is.numeric(x)
  is_cat <- is.character(x) || is.factor(x)

  if (is_cat) {
    tbl <- sort(table(x, useNA = "no"), decreasing = TRUE)
    is_high_card <- length(tbl) / n_total > 0.5
    if (is_high_card) {
      top1 <- "(high-card)"
      top2 <- top3 <- ""
    } else {
      lvl  <- substr(names(tbl), 1, 10)
      top  <- paste0(lvl, " (", tbl, ")")
      top1 <- if (length(top) >= 1) top[1] else ""
      top2 <- if (length(top) >= 2) top[2] else ""
      top3 <- if (length(top) >= 3) top[3] else ""
    }
  } else {
    top1 <- top2 <- top3 <- ""
  }

  tibble(
    type       = if (is_num) "num" else if (is_cat) "cat" else class(x)[1],
    n_missing  = as.character(sum(is.na(x))),
    n_distinct = as.character(dplyr::n_distinct(x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    min        = if (is_num) format(min(x,    na.rm = TRUE), digits = 3) else "",
    p25        = if (is_num) format(quantile(x, .25, na.rm = TRUE), digits = 3) else "",
    median     = if (is_num) format(median(x, na.rm = TRUE), digits = 3) else "",
    mean       = if (is_num) format(mean(x,   na.rm = TRUE), digits = 3) else "",
    p75        = if (is_num) format(quantile(x, .75, na.rm = TRUE), digits = 3) else "",
    max        = if (is_num) format(max(x,    na.rm = TRUE), digits = 3) else "",
    sd         = if (is_num) format(sd(x,     na.rm = TRUE), digits = 3) else "",
    top1       = top1,
    top2       = top2,
    top3       = top3
  )
}

profile <- imap(dat, \(x, name) {
  summarize_var(x, n_total = nrow(dat)) |> mutate(variable = name, .before = 1)
}) |> bind_rows()

profile |>
  kable(booktabs = TRUE) |>
  kable_styling(font_size = 7, latex_options = c("HOLD_position", "striped")) |>
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) |>
  landscape()
```

# Data-quality flags

```{r}
flag_constant <- function(df) {
  vapply(df, function(x) length(unique(na.omit(x))) <= 1L, logical(1)) |>
    which() |>
    names()
}

flag_high_cardinality <- function(df, frac = 0.5) {
  cat_cols <- df |> select(where(~ is.character(.) | is.factor(.))) |> colnames()
  hi <- vapply(cat_cols, function(col) {
    length(unique(df[[col]])) / nrow(df) > frac
  }, logical(1))
  cat_cols[hi]
}

constants    <- flag_constant(dat)
hi_card_cats <- flag_high_cardinality(dat)

fmt_cols <- function(x) if (length(x)) paste0("`", x, "`", collapse = ", ") else "none"
constants_str <- fmt_cols(constants)
hi_card_str   <- fmt_cols(hi_card_cats)
```

- **Constant columns** (single unique value, including all-NA): `r constants_str`.
- **Very high-cardinality categoricals** (>50% of rows have a unique value — likely IDs or free text): `r hi_card_str`.

# Univariate distributions

## Numeric

```{r fig.height=8}
if (ncol(dat_numeric) > 0) {
  dat_numeric |>
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") |>
    ggplot(aes(x = value)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", color = "white", alpha = 0.7) +
    facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 8) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Count")
}
```

## Categorical (top-20 levels per variable)

```{r fig.height=6}
# Drop high-cardinality categoricals (likely IDs): the resulting plot would
# show 20 bars of count = 1 each and be unreadable. They're already flagged
# in §3 Data-quality flags.
dat_cat_plot <- dat_cat |>
  select(where(\(x) dplyr::n_distinct(x, na.rm = TRUE) / length(x) <= 0.5))

if (ncol(dat_cat_plot) > 0) {
  dat_cat_plot |>
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") |>
    group_by(variable, value) |>
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    group_by(variable) |>
    slice_max(n, n = 20) |>
    ungroup() |>
    ggplot(aes(y = reorder_within(value, n, variable), x = n)) +
    geom_col(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
    facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free", ncol = 2) +
    scale_y_reordered() +
    theme_bw(base_size = 8) +
    labs(x = "Count", y = NULL)
}
```

# Pairwise structure

## Spearman correlation matrix

```{r fig.height=6}
if (ncol(dat_numeric) > 1) {
  cor_matrix <- cor(dat_numeric, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "spearman")
  corrplot(
    cor_matrix,
    method = "color", type = "upper",
    tl.cex = 0.7, tl.col = "black",
    addCoef.col = "black", number.cex = 0.5,
    diag = FALSE
  )
}
```

## Boxplots (outlier scan)

```{r fig.height=8}
if (ncol(dat_numeric) > 0) {
  dat_numeric |>
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") |>
    ggplot(aes(x = variable, y = value)) +
    geom_boxplot(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.3,
                 outlier.color = "red", outlier.size = 1) +
    facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 8) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)
}
```


```{r outcome-section-eval, include=FALSE}
has_outcome   <- !is.null(OUTCOME) && all(OUTCOME %in% names(dat))
has_exposures <- !is.null(EXPOSURES) && all(EXPOSURES %in% names(dat))
has_grouping  <- !is.null(GROUPING) && all(GROUPING %in% names(dat))
```

`r if (has_outcome) "# Outcome focus" else ""`

```{r fig.height=4, eval=has_outcome}
y <- OUTCOME[1]

# Distribution
ggplot(dat, aes(x = .data[[y]])) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "steelblue", color = "white", alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(title = paste("Distribution of", y), x = y, y = "Count")
```

```{r fig.height=5, eval=(has_outcome && has_grouping)}
g <- GROUPING[1]

# Outcome by group
ggplot(dat, aes(x = .data[[g]], y = .data[[y]], fill = .data[[g]])) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, outlier.size = 0.7) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(title = paste(y, "by", g), x = g, y = y)
```

`r if (has_exposures && has_outcome) "# Exposure → outcome scatters" else ""`

```{r fig.height=5, eval=(has_exposures && has_outcome)}
walk(EXPOSURES, function(ex) {
  p <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = .data[[ex]], y = .data[[y]])) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(method = "gam", formula = y ~ s(x, k = 6), color = "steelblue", fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.2) +
    labs(title = paste(y, "vs", ex), x = ex, y = y)
  print(p)
})
```

`r if (has_grouping) "# Group structure" else ""`

```{r eval=has_grouping, results='asis'}
for (g in GROUPING) {
  tab <- dat |>
    count(.data[[g]], sort = TRUE) |>
    head(30)
  g_disp <- gsub("_", "\\\\_", g)   # escape underscores for LaTeX caption
  print(kable(tab, booktabs = TRUE,
              caption = paste("Counts by", g_disp, "(top 30 levels)")) |>
        kable_styling(font_size = 8,
                      latex_options = "HOLD_position"))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

# Notes

This report was generated by the `/eda` skill. The always-on baseline runs for any dataset; outcome / exposure / grouping sections appear when you pass those as params. Rerun with focused params to tailor:

```
/eda <path> outcome=<col> exposures=<col,col> grouping=<col>
```

If a section is empty or missing here, it's because the dataset didn't contain enough of that variable type (e.g., no categorical columns means no bar charts).
